Summary test case for the Diabetes Care Weighted Composite over the eight diabetes care test patients, calculated from the component summary test cases ([HbA1c poor control](MeasureReport-DHCComponent-summary.html), [emergency department visits](MeasureReport-DEVComponent-summary.html), and [days to follow-up](MeasureReport-DFUComponent-summary.html)).

| Component | Component Score | Score Range | Normalized Score | Adjusted Score (decrease) | Weight |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| HbA1c Poor Control | 0.4 | 0 to 1 (default) | 0.4 | 0.6 | 0.4 |
| ED Visits | 50 per 1,000 patient-months | 0 to 100 per 1,000 patient-months | 0.5 | 0.5 | 0.3 |
| Days to Follow-up | 9 days (median) | 0 to 30 days | 0.3 | 0.7 | 0.3 |

Expected composite score ((0.4 x 0.6) + (0.3 x 0.5) + (0.3 x 0.7)) / (0.4 + 0.3 + 0.3) = 0.6.
